incarnation: The Crownless Sea — Brann Crow selected individual V2 portrait, original project canon (2026)
sourceLimits: Original project character: current selected individual V2 portrait is internal visual authority, not an independent external franchise source.
Unseen back of coat/axe and exact eye details not fully specified; no automatic perfect1:1 certification.
The source includes other people; they do not qualify Brann identity and are not copied into new solo compositions.
New locations are original age-of-sail Crownless Sea environments coherent with free crews, imperial route control and sea magic; not official screenshots.
CG05 is Nexus adaptation; CG09-11 Fan Art; CG12-15 What If; alternate costume/effects in specials do not redefine Canon identity.
The previous selected atlas is a slim clean-shaven navy-clothed design with no axe; preserved as variant rather than reused as identity.
